mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cover_letter ( user_id , title , industry_idx , job_idx , role_idx , applied_field , company_name , company_idx , career_idx , ai_generated , save_status , created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId} , #{title} , (SELECT industry_idx FROM industry WHERE industry_code = #{industryCode}) , (SELECT job_idx FROM job_group WHERE job_code = #{jobCode}) , (SELECT role_idx FROM job_role WHERE role_code = #{roleCode}) , #{appliedField} , #{companyName} , (SELECT company_idx FROM company_type WHERE company_code = #{companyCode}) , (SELECT career_idx FROM career_level WHERE career_code = #{careerCode}) , #{aiGenerated} , #{saveStatus} , NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT c.cover_letter_idx , c.user_id , c.title , c.content , (select industry_code from industry i where i.industry_idx = c.industry_idx) as industryCode , (select job_code from job_group g where g.job_idx = c.job_idx) as jobCode , (select role_code from job_role r where r.role_idx = c.role_idx) as roleCode , applied_field , company_name , (select company_code from company_type t where t.company_idx = c.company_idx) as companyCode , (select career_code from career_level l where l.career_idx = c.career_idx) as careerCode , (select question_code from question_category q where q.question_idx = c.question_idx) as questionCode , save_status FROM cover_letter c WHERE cover_letter_idx = #{coverLetterIdx}
